{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": "js-to-ts-migrate/migrate.js", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * JavaScript → TypeScript Migration Script
 *
 * Features:
 *   - Renames .js/.jsx → .ts/.tsx
 *   - Infers types from JSDoc, default values, and patterns
 *   - Converts CommonJS require/module.exports → ES import/export
 *   - Adds basic type annotations to functions, variables, and class properties
 *   - Handles React component detection (.jsx → .tsx, React imports)
 *   - Generates tsconfig.json if missing
 *   - Supports dry-run mode, glob patterns, and exclusion filters
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node migrate.js [options] <dir>
 *
 * Options:
 *   --dry-run         Preview changes without writing files
 *   --verbose         Show detailed logs
 *   --exclude <glob>  Exclude files matching glob (can be repeated)
 *   --no-rename       Don't rename files (only transform content)
 *   --jsdoc           Infer types from JSDoc comments (default: true)
 *   --cjs             Convert CommonJS require/exports to ES modules
 *   --react           Ensure React imports for .tsx files
 */

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CLI Argument Parsing
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function parseArgs(argv) {
  const args = {
    dir: null,
    dryRun: false,
    verbose: false,
    exclude: [],
    noRename: false,
    jsdoc: true,
    cjs: false,
    react: false,
  };

  let i = 2; // skip `node` and script name
  while (i < argv.length) {
    const arg = argv[i];
    switch (arg) {
      case "--dry-run":
        args.dryRun = true;
        break;
      case "--verbose":
        args.verbose = true;
        break;
      case "--exclude":
        args.exclude.push(argv[++i]);
        break;
      case "--no-rename":
        args.noRename = true;
        break;
      case "--no-jsdoc":
        args.jsdoc = false;
        break;
      case "--cjs":
        args.cjs = true;
        break;
      case "--react":
        args.react = true;
        break;
      default:
        if (!arg.startsWith("--")) {
          args.dir = arg;
        } else {
          console.warn(`⚠  Unknown flag: ${arg}`);
        }
    }
    i++;
  }

  if (!args.dir) {
    args.dir = ".";
  }

  return args;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Utility helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const LOG_COLORS = {
  reset: "\x1b[0m",
  green: "\x1b[32m",
  yellow: "\x1b[33m",
  cyan: "\x1b[36m",
  red: "\x1b[31m",
  gray: "\x1b[90m",
};

function log(msg, color = "reset") {
  console.log(`${LOG_COLORS[color]}${msg}${LOG_COLORS.reset}`);
}

function verbose(msg) {
  if (CLI_ARGS.verbose) log(`  ${msg}`, "gray");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File discovery
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function walkDir(dir, excludePatterns = []) {
  const results = [];
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      if (entry.name === "node_modules" || entry.name === ".git") continue;
      if (excludePatterns.some((p) => fullPath.includes(p))) continue;
      results.push(...walkDir(fullPath, excludePatterns));
    } else if (/\.(js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$/.test(entry.name)) {
      if (excludePatterns.some((p) => fullPath.includes(p))) continue;
      results.push(fullPath);
    }
  }

  return results;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Type inference helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Infer a TypeScript type from a JavaScript value literal.
 */
function inferTypeFromValue(value) {
  const trimmed = value.trim();

  // String literals
  if (/^["'`]/.test(trimmed) || trimmed.startsWith("`")) return "string";

  // Numeric literals
  if (/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(trimmed)) return "number";

  // Boolean literals
  if (trimmed === "true" || trimmed === "false") return "boolean";

  // Null / undefined
  if (trimmed === "null") return "null";
  if (trimmed === "undefined") return "undefined";

  // Array literals
  if (trimmed.startsWith("[") && trimmed.endsWith("]")) {
    // Try to infer element type
    const inner = trimmed.slice(1, -1).trim();
    if (!inner) return "unknown[]";
    const elements = splitTopLevel(inner, ",");
    const elementTypes = new Set(elements.map((e) => inferTypeFromValue(e)));
    if (elementTypes.size === 1) return `${[...elementTypes][0]}[]`;
    if (elementTypes.size <= 3) return `(${[...elementTypes].join(" | ")})[]`;
    return "unknown[]";
  }

  // Object literals
  if (trimmed.startsWith("{") && trimmed.endsWith("}")) return "object";

  // Regex literals
  if (trimmed.startsWith("/")) return "RegExp";

  // Function expressions
  if (
    trimmed.startsWith("function") ||
    trimmed.startsWith("=>") ||
    trimmed.includes("=>")
  )
    return "Function";

  return "unknown";
}

/**
 * Split a string by a delimiter, but only at the top level (not inside
 * brackets, braces, or parentheses).
 */
function splitTopLevel(str, delimiter) {
  const parts = [];
  let depth = 0;
  let current = "";
  let inString = false;
  let stringChar = "";

  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const ch = str[i];

    if (inString) {
      current += ch;
      if (ch === stringChar && str[i - 1] !== "\\") inString = false;
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") {
      inString = true;
      stringChar = ch;
      current += ch;
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === "(" || ch === "{" || ch === "[") depth++;
    if (ch === ")" || ch === "}" || ch === "]") depth--;

    if (ch === delimiter && depth === 0) {
      parts.push(current.trim());
      current = "";
      continue;
    }

    current += ch;
  }

  if (current.trim()) parts.push(current.trim());
  return parts;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// JSDoc type extraction
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Extract @type, @param, and @returns from JSDoc comments.
 * Returns { type, params: [{name, type}], returns }
 */
function parseJsdoc(jsdoc) {
  const result = { type: null, params: [], returns: null };

  // @type {Type}
  const typeMatch = jsdoc.match(/@type\s*\{([^}]+)\}/);
  if (typeMatch) result.type = typeMatch[1].trim();

  // @param {Type} name
  const paramRegex = /@param\s*\{([^}]+)\}\s+(\w+)/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = paramRegex.exec(jsdoc)) !== null) {
    result.params.push({ name: m[2], type: m[1].trim() });
  }

  // @returns {Type}
  const returnsMatch = jsdoc.match(/@returns?\s*\{([^}]+)\}/);
  if (returnsMatch) result.returns = returnsMatch[1].trim();

  return result;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Transformation functions
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Convert `const x = require("y")` → `import x from "y"`
 * and `const { a, b } = require("y")` → `import { a, b } from "y"`
 */
function convertRequireToImport(source) {
  // const mod = require("module")
  source = source.replace(
    /const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*require\(\s*["']([^"']+)["']\s*\)/g,
    (_, name, mod) => `import ${name} from "${mod}"`
  );

  // const { a, b } = require("module")
  source = source.replace(
    /const\s*\{([^}]+)\}\s*=\s*require\(\s*["']([^"']+)["']\s*\)/g,
    (_, destructure, mod) => `import {${destructure}} from "${mod}"`
  );

  return source;
}

/**
 * Convert `module.exports = X` and `exports.x = Y` to ES exports.
 */
function convertModuleExports(source) {
  // module.exports = value
  source = source.replace(
    /module\.exports\s*=\s*/g,
    "export default "
  );

  // module.exports = { ... }  → export the named members
  // (Kept as `export default` for simplicity — manual review recommended.)

  // exports.name = value  → export const name = value
  source = source.replace(
    /exports\.(\w+)\s*=\s*/g,
    "export const $1 = "
  );

  return source;
}

/**
 * Add TypeScript type annotations to variable declarations when possible.
 * Handles: const, let, var with initializers and JSDoc @type.
 */
function annotateVariables(source, useJsdoc) {
  // --- JSDoc @type annotations ---
  if (useJsdoc) {
    source = source.replace(
      /\/\*\*([^*]|\*[^/])*?\*\/\s*\n\s*(const|let|var)\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*/g,
      (match, jsdocBody, keyword, name) => {
        const parsed = parseJsdoc(match);
        if (parsed.type) {
          return match.replace(
            new RegExp(`(const|let|var)\\s+${name}\\s*=`),
            `${keyword} ${name}: ${parsed.type} =`
          );
        }
        return match;
      }
    );
  }

  // --- Infer from default values (only for simple literals) ---
  // const x = "hello"  →  const x: string = "hello"
  source = source.replace(
    /^( *)((?:const|let|var))\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*(.+)$/gm,
    (match, indent, keyword, name, value) => {
      // Skip if already has type annotation
      if (new RegExp(`${name}\\s*:`).test(match)) return match;
      // Skip complex expressions
      if (value.includes("(") || value.includes("=>") || value.includes("{"))
        return match;
      // Skip if value is an identifier (not a literal)
      if (/^[A-Za-z_$]/.test(value.trim())) return match;

      const type = inferTypeFromValue(value);
      if (type === "unknown") return match;

      return `${indent}${keyword} ${name}: ${type} = ${value}`;
    }
  );

  return source;
}

/**
 * Add parameter type annotations to function declarations.
 * Uses JSDoc @param when available.
 */
function annotateFunctionParams(source, useJsdoc) {
  // --- JSDoc-annotated function declarations ---
  if (useJsdoc) {
    // Match: /** jsdoc */ function name(params) { OR /** jsdoc */ const name = (params) =>
    source = source.replace(
      /(\/\*\*[\s\S]*?\*\/)\s*\n(\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+(\w+)\s*)\(([^)]*)\)/g,
      (match, jsdoc, prefix, fnName, params) => {
        const parsed = parseJsdoc(jsdoc);
        if (parsed.params.length === 0) return match;

        const newParams = annotateParamsFromJsdoc(params, parsed.params);
        return `${jsdoc}\n${prefix}(${newParams})`;
      }
    );

    // Arrow functions with JSDoc
    source = source.replace(
      /(\/\*\*[\s\S]*?\*\/)\s*\n(\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:const|let)\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*(?:async\s+)?)\(([^)]*)\)\s*=>/g,
      (match, jsdoc, prefix, fnName, params) => {
        const parsed = parseJsdoc(jsdoc);
        if (parsed.params.length === 0) return match;

        const newParams = annotateParamsFromJsdoc(params, parsed.params);
        return `${jsdoc}\n${prefix}(${newParams}) =>`;
      }
    );
  }

  // --- Add `any` to untyped parameters (as a fallback for strict mode) ---
  // function foo(a, b) → function foo(a: any, b: any)
  source = source.replace(
    /(function\s+\w+\s*)\(([^)]*)\)/g,
    (match, prefix, params) => {
      if (!params.trim()) return match;
      if (params.includes(":")) return match; // already typed

      const newParams = params
        .split(",")
        .map((p) => {
          const trimmed = p.trim();
          if (!trimmed) return "";
          // Skip rest params and default values
          if (trimmed.startsWith("...")) return `${trimmed}: any[]`;
          if (trimmed.includes("=")) {
            const [name, defVal] = trimmed.split("=");
            const type = inferTypeFromValue(defVal);
            return `${name}: ${type !== "unknown" ? type : "any"} = ${defVal}`;
          }
          return `${trimmed}: any`;
        })
        .join(", ");

      return `${prefix}(${newParams})`;
    }
  );

  // Arrow function params: (a, b) => ... → (a: any, b: any) => ...
  source = source.replace(
    /(?:const|let)\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*(?:async\s+)?\(([^)]*)\)\s*=>/g,
    (match, name, params) => {
      if (!params.trim()) return match;
      if (params.includes(":")) return match;

      const newParams = params
        .split(",")
        .map((p) => {
          const trimmed = p.trim();
          if (!trimmed) return "";
          if (trimmed.startsWith("...")) return `${trimmed}: any[]`;
          if (trimmed.includes("=")) {
            const [paramName, defVal] = trimmed.split("=");
            const type = inferTypeFromValue(defVal);
            return `${paramName}: ${type !== "unknown" ? type : "any"} = ${defVal}`;
          }
          return `${trimmed}: any`;
        })
        .join(", ");

      return match.replace(/\(([^)]*)\)\s*=>/, `(${newParams}) =>`);
    }
  );

  return source;
}

/**
 * Given a raw parameter string and parsed JSDoc params, return annotated params.
 */
function annotateParamsFromJsdoc(paramsStr, jsdocParams) {
  const params = paramsStr.split(",").map((p) => p.trim());

  const annotated = params.map((param, i) => {
    const jsdocParam = jsdocParams.find(
      (jp) => jp.name === param || jp.name === param.replace(/[.=].*$/, "")
    );

    if (jsdocParam) {
      return `${param}: ${jsdocParam.type}`;
    }
    return param.includes(":") ? param : `${param}: any`;
  });

  return annotated.join(", ");
}

/**
 * Add return type annotations to functions using JSDoc @returns.
 */
function annotateReturnTypes(source, useJsdoc) {
  if (!useJsdoc) return source;

  // function name(params): ReturnType {
  source = source.replace(
    /(\/\*\*[\s\S]*?\*\/)\s*\n(\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+\w+\s*\([^)]*\))\s*\{/g,
    (match, jsdoc, sig) => {
      const parsed = parseJsdoc(jsdoc);
      if (parsed.returns) {
        return `${jsdoc}\n${sig}: ${parsed.returns} {`;
      }
      return match;
    }
  );

  return source;
}

/**
 * Add basic class property types.
 */
function annotateClassProperties(source) {
  // Handle class properties defined in constructor
  // this.name = value  →  this.name = value  (add comment about type)
  source = source.replace(
    /(\s+)(this\.\w+)\s*=\s*([^;\n]+);/g,
    (match, indent, prop, value) => {
      const type = inferTypeFromValue(value);
      if (type === "unknown") return match;
      // Add a comment hint for class property type
      return `${indent}// Type: ${type}\n${match}`;
    }
  );

  return source;
}

/**
 * Ensure React is imported in .tsx files if JSX is used.
 */
function ensureReactImport(source) {
  const hasJsx = /<\w+[^>]*>/.test(source);
  const hasReactImport =
    /import\s+React\b/.test(source) ||
    /import\s+\*\s+as\s+React\b/.test(source);

  if (hasJsx && !hasReactImport) {
    return `import React from "react";\n${source}`;
  }
  return source;
}

/**
 * Fix relative import paths: add .js → .ts extension adjustment.
 * In TypeScript, imports typically omit extensions or use .ts at compile time.
 * We strip extensions from relative imports for broad compatibility.
 */
function fixImportExtensions(source) {
  // import X from "./foo.js" → import X from "./foo"
  source = source.replace(
    /(from\s+["'])(\.\.?\/[^"']+)\.(js|jsx|mjs|cjs)(["'])/g,
    "$1$2$4"
  );

  // import X from "./foo" (no extension) — leave as-is (TypeScript resolves it)

  return source;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main transformation pipeline
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function transformSource(source, options, isJsx) {
  let result = source;

  // 1. Convert CommonJS → ES Modules
  if (options.cjs) {

    result = convertRequireToImport(result);

An automated migration tool that converts JavaScript projects to TypeScript, handling file renaming, type inference, and common syntactic transformations.

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **File Renaming** | `.js` → `.ts`, `.jsx` → `.tsx` |
| **Type Inference** | Infers types from literal values (`"hello"` → `string`, `42` → `number`) |
| **JSDoc Extraction** | Reads `@type`, `@param`, `@returns` and converts to TS annotations |
| **CommonJS → ESM** | Converts `require()` / `module.exports` to `import` / `export` |
| **Function Annotations** | Adds parameter and return type annotations |
| **React Support** | Ensures React import in `.tsx` files |
| **Import Path Cleanup** | Strips `.js`/`.jsx` extensions from relative imports |
| **tsconfig Generation** | Creates a starter `tsconfig.json` if missing |
| **Dry Run Mode** | Preview all changes before writing |

## Quick Start

```bash
# Preview changes (no files modified)
node migrate.js --dry-run ./src

# Apply the migration
node migrate.js ./src

# With CommonJS conversion and React support
node migrate.js --cjs --react ./src

# Verbose output with exclusions
node migrate.js --verbose --exclude "__tests__" --exclude "legacy" ./src
```

## CLI Options

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | Preview changes without writing files |
| `--verbose` | Show detailed transformation logs |
| `--exclude <glob>` | Exclude files/paths matching pattern (repeatable) |
| `--no-rename` | Transform content only; don't rename `.js` → `.ts` |
| `--no-jsdoc` | Skip JSDoc-based type inference |
| `--cjs` | Convert CommonJS `require`/`exports` to ES modules |
| `--react` | Ensure React imports for JSX-containing files |

## How It Works

### 1. Variable Type Inference

```javascript
// Before
const name = "Alice";
const count = 42;
const active = true;
const items = [1, 2, 3];

// After
const name: string = "Alice";
const count: number = 42;
const active: boolean = true;
const items: number[] = [1, 2, 3];
```

### 2. JSDoc → TypeScript Annotations

```javascript
// Before
/**
 * @param {string} name - The user's name
 * @param {number} age - The user's age
 * @returns {object}
 */
function createUser(name, age) {

// After
/**
 * @param {string} name - The user's name
 * @param {number} age - The user's age
 * @returns {object}
 */
function createUser(name: string, age: number): object {
```

### 3. CommonJS → ES Modules (`--cjs`)

```javascript
// Before
const express = require("express");
const { Router } = require("express");
module.exports = app;
exports.handler = function() {};

// After
import express from "express";
import { Router } from "express";
export default app;
export const handler = function() {};
```

### 4. Untyped Parameters → `any` Fallback

```javascript
// Before
function process(data, options) {

// After
function process(data: any, options: any) {
```

### 5. Import Path Cleanup

```javascript
// Before
import { foo } from "./utils.js";
import { bar } from "./helpers.jsx";

// After
import { foo } from "./utils";
import { bar } from "./helpers";
```

## Post-Migration Checklist

1. **Run `tsc --noEmit`** — Check for type errors
2. **Enable strict mode incrementally** — Set `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`
3. **Replace `any` types** — Define proper interfaces and type aliases
4. **Add return types** — The script annotates from JSDoc; review others manually
5. **Verify imports** — Especially after CommonJS conversion
6. **Run your test suite** — Ensure no behavioral regressions

## Limitations

- **No runtime type inference** — Only static analysis of literals and JSDoc
- **Complex expressions skipped** — Objects, function calls, etc. are not auto-typed
- **Class properties** — Added as comments rather than proper TS property declarations (requires `useDefineForClassFields`)
- **Dynamic imports** — Not transformed; handle manually
- **Mixed CJS/ESM** — Some edge cases in CommonJS conversion may need review
